ENGLISH: The Khorasan forces have defeated us. We are now forced to surrender large parts of our territory to them...

Our forces have been defeated by another Caliph and we have been forced to accept their demands. Our Caliphate, truest of the Faithful, will seize to exist. We have to abandon our claim to the position of Caliph, and accept them as the true Caliphate. We must now decide what form of government our nation shall have following our defeat.
